description:
Find every company where several different insiders made OPEN-MARKET purchases (option exercises, awards and
sales excluded), list each buyer's name, title and amount, and FLAG BATCHES: many buyers filing on the same day
with similar, modest amounts usually means one company program (employee purchase plan, IPO or private-placement
allocation), not independent conviction. Each company gets a 0–100 conviction score (independent buyers, C-suite
participation, size per buyer, how much they grew their stake, purchases spread over several days, minus batch
penalty) with reasons. Use for 'find companies where 3+ insiders bought in the last 60 days', 'cluster buying
that is real, not a comp plan', 'rank insider clusters by conviction'.

exclude_batches.description: True = hide companies whose buying looks like one company program (same day, similar small amounts).
